start.speaker: Elara
start.text: You had it and then you did not come back with it. I would call that a bad trade if I thought a trade had taken place.

r2.speaker: Elara
r2.text: Deep, and nothing to show. I will still buy what is in your pockets. I always buy what is in your pockets.

r3.speaker: Elara
r3.text: Cleared. Then you have things worth naming a price for, and I have a price ready for each of them.

r4.speaker: Elara
r4.text: The caverns. Everything that comes up from there is bright and worth less than it looks. I say that against my own interest.

r5.speaker: Elara
r5.text: Ten deaths. The stock is unchanged, which is the only steady thing either of us can point to.

quiet.speaker: Elara
quiet.text: Stock turns over. Buyers do not. Look anyway.
